source_text: 1. Jupicasnrr autem et eos qui schismata operantur, qui sunt inanes, non habentes Dei dilectionem, suamque utilitatem potius considerantes quam unitatem Ecclesiz : et propter modicas et quaslibet causas magnum et gloriosum corpus Christi conscindunt et dividunt, et quantum in ipsis est, interficiunt: pacem loquentes et bellum operantes: vere liquantes culicem et cametransglutientes. Nulla enim ab eis tanta potest fieri correctio, quanta est schismatis pernicies. Judicabit autem et omnes eos qui sunt extra veritatem, id est qui sunt extra Ecclesiam: ipse autem a nemine judicabitur. Omnia enim ei constant: et in unum Deum omnipotentem, ex quo omnia, fides integra; et in nat eis +O Filium Dei Christum Jesum Dominum nostrum, per quem omnia, — et dispositiones ejus, per quas homo factus est Filius Dei, sententia firma, quze est in Spiritu Dei, qui preestat agnitionem veritatis, qui dispositiones Patris et Filii exposuit, secundum quas aderat generi humano, quemadmodum vult Pater.
pass_a_gloss: But also those who make schisms, who are empty, not having God's love, and considering their own advantage rather than the unity of the Church: and on account of small and whatever causes they cut and divide the great and glorious body of Christ, and as far as it is in them, they kill: speaking peace and making war: truly straining out a gnat and swallowing a camel. For no such great correction can be made by them, as is the destruction of schism. But He will judge also all those who are outside the truth, that is, who are outside the Church: but He Himself will be judged by no one. For all things are steadfast for Him: and in one God omnipotent, from whom all things, complete faith; and in the Son of God Christ Jesus our Lord, through whom all things, — and the dispositions of Him, through which man was made the Son of God, firm opinion, which is in the Spirit of God, who supplies the knowledge of truth, who explained the dispositions of the Father and the Son, according to which He was present to the human race, as the Father wills.

choices.english: as far as it is in them
rejected: to the best of their ability

choices.english: for no such great correction can be made by them
rejected: for they cannot make such a great correction
choices.term: nulla enim ab eis tanta potest fieri correctio

pass_b_english: Consider also those who create schisms. They are hollow, lacking the love of God, and they weigh their own advantage more heavily than the unity of the Church. Over trifling and arbitrary causes they tear apart the great and glorious body of Christ, and insofar as they are able, they kill it. They speak of peace but wage war, truly straining out a gnat while swallowing a camel. No correction they might offer can ever match the destruction that schism brings. He will judge all who stand outside the truth — that is, outside the Church — yet He Himself will be judged by no one. All things hold fast for Him: complete faith in one God Almighty, from whom all things come; faith in the Son of God, Christ Jesus our Lord, through whom all things exist; and a firm conviction, rooted in the Spirit of God, concerning His dispensations, by which humanity was made the Son of God. This Spirit supplies the knowledge of truth and has unfolded the dispensations of the Father and the Son, according to which He drew near to the human race, just as the Father willed.

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Latin text, including the handling of OCR errors (e.g., 'Jupicasnrr' interpreted as 'judicare' and 'cametransglutientes' as 'swallowing a camel'). Pass B provides a fluent rendering of the complex final clauses while maintaining the theological distinctions and causal relations present in the Latin and Pass A.
